name: Coding Club
tagline: Build things, break things, ship things.
description: Weekly build sessions, hackathon prep, and friendly code reviews. Bring a laptop and an idea; no experience needed.

name: Photography Society
tagline: See campus the way no one else does.
description: Monthly photo walks, an annual exhibition, and a shared darkroom. Phones are completely fine.

name: Dramatics Club
tagline: The stage is always half the fun.
description: Two productions a year plus open-mic nights. Actors, writers, and backstage crew are all welcome.

name: Yoga & Mindfulness
description: Sunrise yoga on the lawn, guided meditation, and a no-phones tea break every week.

name: Chai & Board Games
tagline: Cards, chess, and chai. No pressure.
description: A relaxed corner of campus for board games, card nights, and long chats over chai.

name: Sports Committee
description: Runs inter-department leagues across cricket, football, badminton, and athletics all year.
